Karina (PM): Heads-up: were scheduling the adaptive-routing rollout next week. Scope: staged regions, tenant opt-ins for enterprise customers, A/B quality guards, and automated fallback to legacy routing. Need owners for each safety gate and the runbook.

Matt (Eng Lead): Ill own the rollout scripts and the feature-flag plumbing. Proposed ramp: 0.1% smoke -> 2% small canary -> 15% load -> 60% expansion -> 100%. Suggest shorter bakes for the first two (30m) and 4h for 15% and 60%; manual approval before 60%->100%.

Sasha (SRE): Add a 5-minute grace/warmup for cache/KV priming at each region step. For any regional ramp >=15% we pre-warm a minimal pool of GPU instances to avoid latency spikes. Also want an automatic circuit-breaker with a 5-min cooloff that shifts traffic back to routing-legacy.

Leo (Product Ops): Gating checklist idea: fail the step if ANY of these happen:
- p95 latency increase > 15% vs baseline for >2 buckets
- request error rate > 1.2x baseline AND absolute errors > 1%
- A/B quality metric drop (Amal) > 1% over two consecutive 15m windows
- per-tenant cost delta > 10% (billing impact) for paying customers
We also need a kill-switch runbook with oncall contacts and a quick rollback play.

Priya (CS): BetaCorp needs to opt-in and have a custom monitoring SLA. We must expose a per-tenant holdback flag and send a targeted email + in-app banner before their ramp. Also need a one-click holdback for the CS dashboard.

Amal (Data): For the A/B quality check well run continuous evals on a seeded prompt set plus customer shadow logs (where permitted). Metrics: exact-match, BLEU-ish similarity, and hallucination-rate. Gate if two of three metrics breach thresholds over 30m windows. Ill deliver baseline numbers and a dashboard.

Matt (Eng Lead): Example flag schema well push to flags-service:```json
{"name":"adaptive-routing","variants":["control","adaptive_v1"],"steps":[{"pct":0.1,"regions":["us-west"]},{"pct":2,"regions":["us-west","eu-west"]},{"pct":15,"regions":["*"]},{"pct":60,"regions":["*"]},{"pct":100,"regions":["*"]}],"per_tenant_holdback":true,"kill_switch":"flags.disable.adaptive-routing"}
```Use tenant-hash seeding so whole tenants stay in same bucket unless explicitly overridden.

Sasha (SRE): Fallback policy: on circuit trip, immediate split 90/10 to legacy (90 legacy, 10 variant for continued signal) for 10min then escalate. If error spike persists beyond 10min, auto-rollback full traffic to legacy and page #eng-oncall + oncall. Add metric-rule: if p50 latency doubles or p99 > 500ms for 5m, trigger canary circuit.

Karina (PM): Owners & tasks: Matt (scripts + flags), Amal (eval harness + dashboards), Sasha (circuit breaker + capacity), Leo (customer comms + runbook), Priya (customer opt-ins + CS dashboard). Can we do a dry-run Thursday at 0.1% in staging?

Matt (Eng Lead): Dry-run Thursday OK. Ill schedule a staging flag and run traffic generator across us-west/eu-west. Will report results here.

deploy-bot: scheduled flag push to staging at 2026-04-02T18:00Z for adaptive-routing (staging). :satellite:

Leo (Product Ops): Ill draft the rollout-playbook and include a snippet for customer notice language and the kill-switch steps. Will link the doc here once ready.

Amal (Data): Ill wire eval alerts into PagerDuty and create a condensed PM view for quick bakes. Also adding a nightly drift check for the seeded prompt set.

Priya (CS): Ill prepare BetaCorp messaging and get their opt-in confirmation. Also confirm which tenants need the holdback.

Karina (PM): Nice. Reminder: require two approvers for advancing beyond 15% (one Eng, one Product) and record approvals in rollout audit logs. Keep buckets tied to tenant hash so no tenant gets split across control/variant unless allowed.
